entries.heading: (a) Amounts provided for ``Coast Guard--Operations and
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 16004. (a) Amounts provided for ``Coast Guard--Operations and 
Support'' in the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2020 (Public Law 116-
93) may be available for pay and benefits of

[[Page 134 STAT. 545]]

Coast Guard Yard and Vessel Documentation personnel, Non-Appropriated 
Funds personnel, and for Morale, Welfare and Recreation Programs.
    (b) No amounts may be used under this section from amounts that were 
designated by the Congress for Overseas Contingency Operations/Global 
War on Terrorism pursuant to the Concurrent Resolution on the Budget or 
the Balanced Budget and Emergency Deficit Control Act of 1985.
